name: 24-Hour Room Service Secret "Cake of the Day" & Assorted Pastries
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · 24-Hour Stateroom Dining
whyItWorks: Off-menu DCL insider favorite: ask Room Service what the rotating "Cake of the Day" is—often a vanilla sponge, chocolate mousse cake, or cheesecake.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask the Room Service operator for the flavor of the Cake of the Day; accept if vanilla, chocolate, caramel, or banana, and decline if lemon, orange, key lime, or nut-crusted.
watchOuts: Always verify the daily flavor has zero citrus or nuts before ordering
